title: Cottage in heart of Franklin, TN
description:
Our cozy cottage is nestled behind our home in Hillsboro Acres (Franklin, TN), only 3 miles from historic downtown Franklin, 14 miles from Music Row and downtown Nashville and 17 miles from Arrington Vineyards. Perfect for a couples getaway or a small family. There is a fenced in backyard that is shared with the main house.

Guest access
Feel free to enjoy the backyard, as well as the trampoline

Other things to note
If cooking, please use the countertop vent, which is located in the cabinet just to the right of the stove.
